nodes.label: Extraction confidence and provenance
nodes.rationale: EXTRACTED, INFERRED, and AMBIGUOUS edges preserve the distinction between explicit evidence and inference; absolute source paths support correct incremental replacement.

nodes.label: Vocabulary-constrained query expansion
nodes.rationale: Query matching lacks stemming and synonyms, so expansion must use graph vocabulary to avoid zero-hit searches.

nodes.label: Deterministic AST extraction
nodes.rationale: Code structure is extracted deterministically without an API key or LLM cost.
nodes.source_location: Part A - Structural extraction for code files

nodes.label: Project graph-first navigation policy
nodes.rationale: Query scoped subgraphs before browsing full reports or raw source; refresh the graph after code changes.

nodes.label: Atlas slicing and normalization required
nodes.rationale: The 1254-pixel output cannot be divided evenly into four cells; regions need normalization before regular Godot tile atlas setup, and tile edge continuity needs checking.
